Appendix A — Suggested Report Structure (recommended, not mandated)
Title (recommended element, mandatory in practice)
Abstract (one paragraph: aims → methods → findings → conclusions)
Chapter 1. Introduction
Chapter 2. Background / Related Work
Chapter 3. Methods
Chapter 4. Results
Chapter 5. Discussion
Chapter 6. Conclusions
References / Bibliography (mandatory, follows Conclusions)
Appendices (follow References; project-specification appendix mandatory)
Workshop abstract feature list (background 1–2, aim 1, method 2–3, results 2–4, conclusion 1–2 sentences)
Suggested Methods internal split: data & source → EDA → theory/notation → models → estimation framework → validation
System-design/computing project variant — explain the system construct and components
Data-analytic project variant — data sourcing, structure, exploration, model formulation and evaluation
SciTech narrative arc: Situation → Problem → Solution(s) → Evaluation
SciTech arc: Situation (introduction/background/context)
SciTech arc: Problem (knowledge gap; DS/AI research question)
SciTech arc: Solution(s) (modelling, analyses, design, experiments)
SciTech arc: Evaluation (how well the solution answers the RQ; comparison; next steps)
